newsitem.title: KENYA: Anjouan governor resigns - French radio.
newsitem.headline: Anjouan governor resigns - French radio.

text.p: The governor of the breakaway Comoran island of Anjouan resigned on Sunday, Radio France International reported.

The radio, monitored in Kenya by the British Broadcasting Corporation (BBC), said Cheikh Alloui who was appointed governor by the Comoros government during secessionist demonstrations last month on the Indian Ocean island, had handed his letter of resignation to separatist leaders.

Anjouan declared independence from the Federal Islamic Republic of the Comoros early in August, saying that the membership of the federation since independence from France in 1975 had brought only coups, poverty and civil strife.
Anjouan is the second largest of the Comoros Islands, which have a population of 670,000. Moheli, the smallest of the three-island group, has also declared its independence.
